### 🌷 Orgin Event™ Petals on Wheels

We are proud to present **Orgin Event™ Petals on Wheels**, a special seasonal convoy celebrating the beauty of spring as we journey together through stunning scenic routes and blooming landscapes. Expect smooth driving, professional convoy management, and a memorable experience hosted by the Orgin Event™ team.

Get ready for a relaxing and well-organized ride filled with vibrant spring vibes, peaceful roads, and an amazing trucking community. This event is designed to deliver a realistic, enjoyable, and unforgettable convoy experience for every participant.

Whether you are joining with your VTC or as a public driver, everyone is warmly welcome to be part of this blooming journey on the road! 🌿

---

### 𝒊 EVENT DETAILS

➤  **Meetup Time:** 14:00pm UTC

➤  **Departure Time:** 15:00pm UTC

➤  **Server:** To be determined

➤  **Start Location:** TruckerMP HQ 

➤  **Destination:** Strasbourg (Steinbruch)

➤  **Distance:** **1093 KM**

➤  **Main Language:** English

➤  **DLC Required:** No DLC required

---

### 🗺️ ROUTE INFORMATION

### Route from TruckerMP HQ ( Slot's ) to Strasbourg (Steinbruch)
The convoy will follow a **carefully planned and scenic route** to ensure:

![Route Image](https://i.8upload.com/image/5019bb6db3faefaf/1.jpg)

---

### 📝 SLOT BOOKING

## Book Your Slot:[CLICKHERE](https://discord.gg/fsFTcCQwRw)

`Available Slot List.`

* VTCs can request **dedicated slots**
* Public drivers are welcome without booking
* Follow parking instructions upon arrival

![Convoy Slots](https://i.8upload.com/image/b8bd9d0eac5f73b6/f7.jpg)

---

### 🚧 CONVOY CONTROL

# Event is Supervised By [MidNight Supervision](https://discord.gg/ZsRDGkR37C)

[![](https://chirag.sirv.com/Images/Midnight_tmp_cc_banner.png)](https://discord.gg/ZsRDGkR37C)

---


### ⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES

* Arrive at least 15 minutes before departure 🌷
* Make sure your truck is fully fueled and ready 🌼
* Use only permitted trailers (no doubles unless allowed) 💐
* Stay patient, drive safely, and enjoy the convoy 🍃

---

### 🤍 FINAL MESSAGE

Let’s make this Petals on Wheels convoy blooming, scenic, and unforgettable together.
We can’t wait to cruise with you through the beautiful spring roads! 🌼

---
event_request.rules:
**Event Rules for Participants**:

* The Event Staff are recognized as: “MidN1ght | CCM, MidN1ght | PM , MidN1ght | CC, MidN1ght | Lead, MidN1ght | Tail, MidN1ght | GM" or similar.
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must haul a trailer.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers, and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited (except Event Staff).
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot, you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

**Event Rules for Event Staff**:

* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds, providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY, in accordance with the rule above.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
